continuities.name: The Dark Tower (novels)
continuities.description: Stephen King's eight Dark Tower novels plus the novella The Little Sisters of Eluria, ordered by the series' own volume numbering (0.5, 1-4, 4.5, 5-7).
continuities.quote: "The Dark Tower is a series of eight novels, one novella, and a children's book written by American author Stephen King." Main-series table numbers the volumes 0.5 (The Little Sisters of Eluria), 1, 2, 3, 4, 4.5 (The Wind Through the Keyhole), 5, 6, 7.

continuities.name: The Dark Tower (Marvel comics)
continuities.description: Marvel (later Gallery 13) comics plotted by Robin Furth and scripted by Peter David: a prequel run (Beginnings), then adaptations of The Gunslinger and The Drawing of the Three with new material. Kept separate from the novels: it is an adaptation/expansion, not the novels themselves.
continuities.quote: "The Dark Tower, first published in 2007, is a series of comic books (originally published by Marvel Comics and later republished by Gallery 13) based on Stephen King's The Dark Tower series of novels." ... "the remaining volumes ... contained mostly new/original content which expanded upon details and events more briefly referenced throughout the novels."

continuities.name: The Dark Tower (2017 film)
continuities.description: Sony/MRC film. Wikipedia calls it a canonical sequel to the novels (Roland's next cycle), but it is a separate screen canon with its own events, so it gets its own continuity with a 'continues' link to book 7.
continuities.quote: Film article lead: "The film is also a canonical sequel to the novels." Series article: "The film combines elements from several novels in The Dark Tower series, serving as a canonical sequel to the novel series. ... In July 2016, director Nikolaj Arcel confirmed that The Dark Tower film would be a sequel to the novels as well as a direct adaptation, with Roland in the next cycle of his journey to the Tower."
